commentary.text: Holy [ __ ] this thing is pretty good just spamming 130s at him.
And notice the animation how you arrogantly just wave it around.
You weren't able to double jump or [ __ ] air dash.
It's so lucky I don't get up in there.

textNotes.text: Filmed on launch day, our Velgar Boss Guide for RuneScape: Dragonwilds features our narrator Lord Hooks taking on the game's first major boss completely foodless while using endgame Ancestral armor and Kuldra's Wrath to showcase essential combat mechanics for newcomers.
